title: Sandbox payment provider seam, webhook evidence and reconciliation
claims: payment intent is linked to an existing authorized purchase commitment
sandbox payment initiation is idempotent and conflicting reuse fails closed
provider webhook authenticity is verified by an injected verifier rather than caller assertion
tampered amounts are rejected before canonical payment evidence is recorded
verified terminal provider messages become typed payment evidence
confirmed member payment remains restricted prepayment rather than earned revenue or unrestricted capital
same webhook event replay is idempotent and a second event for the same provider reference cannot duplicate economic effect
scope: Sandbox adapter only; no live Mobile Money provider, live funds, production webhook signature scheme or production launch authorization.
